description: A smartphone and a white charging cable are lying on the bed in front of a pillow. The right hand reaches to the phone, lifts it and turns it so the charging port faces down, while the left hand brings the cable tip over and plugs it into the bottom of the phone; the right-hand object is the phone and the left-hand object is the cable. The right hand then lowers the phone back onto the bed and releases it while the cable stays connected.
